We Are Building Data Centers Blind

[image: Aerial photograph taken from an airplane looking down over a large data center complex in West Jordan near 90th South. The facility spans multiple city blocks, with several massive white-roofed buildings, rows of mechanical equipment, and surrounding infrastructure. The data center sits directly beside established residential neighborhoods, with homes lining the edge of the complex. Nearby are major roads, a baseball field, commercial buildings, industrial areas, showing the scale of the facility in relation to the surrounding community.]
